items.title: Three dead and eight injured in Philippines school shooting
items.description: The gunman is among the dead in what is the third school shooting in the country since June.

items.title: Police begin operation to move migrants from Ceuta beaches
items.description: Police reportedly fired into the air on Friday morning as they struggled to contain crowds jostling to secure a place at the tented site.

items.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
items.description: It is the first time the juror, who refused to side with the others and acquit Clancy, has spoken publicly about his decision.

items.title: At least 16 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams into Pakistan mosque
items.description: A vehicle loaded with explosives rammed into a mosque building during Friday prayers, a senior police official says.

items.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
items.description: A spotted wildcat long mistaken for relatives has been identified as a new species in Bolivia.

items.title: Dozens of suspected illegal miners die in Nigerian custody
items.description: Authorities linked the deaths to disease, but this has been disputed by intelligence reports and relatives of the accused.

items.title: Japan raises interest rate to new 31-year high to curb rising prices
items.description: Central banks around the world have hiked rates as high energy prices are pushing up inflation.

items.title: 'This is our company': Nigerians show off oil wealth after share-buying frenzy
items.description: Many Nigerians buy their first ever shares - in the oil refinery owned by Africa's richest man, Aliko Dangote.

items.title: Zara Larsson criticises White House for using her song in deportation video
items.description: The White House removed Larsson's Midnight Sun from one of its reels after the artist called the clip "dehumanising".

items.title: Canada welcomes EU proposal to become 'associate member'
items.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said a Canada-EU alliance would create a "beacon for other democracies".

items.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
items.description: South Africa police have cautioned against assuming that all the killings are linked but many women are afraid.

items.title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
items.description: The US has not acknowledged carrying out February's deadly strikes on a primary school in Minab and a sports complex in Lamerd.
